$comment: Ceilings for the published WASM web bundle, enforced by scripts/check-wasm-size.js.
Measured on the tranche-50 dependency diet (agent-spreadsheet 0.14.0) and set at
the measured size plus 10 percent. These are meant to ratchet down: raising one
requires a reason in the commit message.
Measured (5006, renderer compiled in): raw 9212266, brotli 2250996. The raster
renderer plus its subset fonts cost 635647 B raw (+7.4 percent) and 191637 B
brotli (+9.3 percent), inside the 1.5 MiB raw allowance the ticket set, so the
ceilings are unchanged. Brotli headroom is now 0.6 percent: the next feature
that grows the bundle has to shrink something or justify a raise.
wasm-opt trades transfer size for compile size: at -Oz raw drops 16 percent but
brotli grows about 6 percent (unoptimized: raw 10941088, brotli 2128546).
